content: Chaura noganchiga nä ali yupachicugcama cayarga chay mana aläpa yupachicug-mayinchicunata imanaypa ayganaypas yanapayäshun mas yupachicugmancama muyupäcunanpag. Nätan ama quiquilanchimanga aläpa pinsiarayäshunchu.
Lapanchisi noganchiga ima-aygatas rurachwan alicagtam runa-mayinchiwan cushisha cawananchipag, jinaman Dioslaman yupachicugcama capäcunanpag.
Cristosi manam quiquilanman yaparayälarchu cawara. Antis payga cawara isquirbishachru Dios ningannuylam. Diosga cay niram: “Ashlishugniquicuna nogatam ashlipäcamasha” niyanmi.
Lapansi chay unaypita isquirbishacunaga yachrayächimanchi chaynuyla Diosman yupachicuyänanchipagmi. Chauraga isquirbishacuna nimanganchinuy shuyacuyäshun wanushapita cawacämunanchita.
Nätan ima-aygatas awantay yanapämagninchi, jinaman calpanchächimagninchi Tayta Dios yanapapäcushunqui lapaycunatas juc shongola Jesucristonuysi cawapäcunaypag,
chaynuypa juc runanuyla Munayniyogninchi Jesuspa Taytanta alawapäcunaypag.
Chauraga Cristo alipa ricapäcushungaynuy jucniquis jucniquis, alipag ricanacurcay Tayta Diosta runacuna alawapäcunanpag.
Cayta niyärishay: Jesusga shamura, Israel castacunata Diospa willapanta musyachinanpagmi jinaman paycunapa awilluncunata “Rurashagmi” ningancuna ruracänanpagmi.
Jinaman shamura Dios cuyapäcug canganpita juc casta runacuna Diosta alawapäcunanpagmi. Chaynuymi isquirbishachrüsi cay niyan:

content.text: “Nogaga juc casta runacunatam razoncag Dios cangayta

content: Nätan yapaytan isquirbishachrüga cay niyan:

content.text: “Juc casta runacuna, Israel casta runacunawan cushicurcay” niyan.

content: Yapaysi isquirbishachrüga
Chaypitaga Diospa willacugnin Isaías isquirbinganchrüsi cay niyanmi:

content.text: Jinarcurmi chay runacunaga payman yupachicurcanga” niyanmi.

content: Nogaga Tayta Diosta manacuyä cushishata, jinaman shumagla cawayta yanapapäcushunaypagmi. Chaura Santu Espiritum yanapapäcushunqui chay wanushapita cawacapäcamunayta chaynuyla shuyarayta.

Jesusman yupachicug-mayïcuna, noga shumagmi musyayä gamcuna ali shongo capäcungaytas, jinaman Diospa willapanta ali yachracuyar carcayangaytas. Chaynuy capäcur gamcunaga carcayanqui alim jucniquis jucniquis piñapänacurcänaypag.
Nätan cay cartachru isquirbiyämü mana gongapäcunaypagmi, nä musyarcayaptiquis, nogataga cuyapälarmi Tayta Diosga nimasha chaynuy nipäcunagpag.
Jinaman nirayämantan juc casta runacunata Diospa ali willapanta willanäpagsi, chaynuypa paycuna juc ali ofrendanuy capäcunanpag, jinaman Santu Espíritu yanapaptin Dioslapag cawagcama capäcunanpag.
Chaura nogaga Jesusman yupachicug car, Diosta chaynuy serviyar alisca cushisham cayä.
Nogaga manam quiquiläpitaga imatas rimächu. Rimayäga nogawan Jesucristo imatas rurangantam. Chayta willapacungäpam, jinaman imatas rurangäpam juc casta runacuna Diosta cäsucurcayan.

Jinaman Santu Espíritu yanapämaptin ima-aygatas ruraypam. Chaynuymi imacunatas alisca rurasha cä. Chaynuypam nogaga Cristopita willapacug cangäta musyachisha cä, maychru chaychrüsi, Jerusalenpita galayur, Ilírico ningancama lapan runata.
Chaynuypam imanaypanuysi ali willapata willapäcamusha cä maychrüsi Cristopita mana imaysi mayapäcungancunachru, chay juccuna yachrachipäcungalanta mana yapay yachrachinäpag.
Nogaga yachrachimurä isquirbishachru cay ningannuymi: “Jesuspita mana imaysi mayacusha runacunam mayacurcanga, jinaman mana imaysi paypita mayashacunam tantiapäcunga” ningannuymi.
Chaynuy rurarmi nogaga gamcuna ricag achca cuti aywamuyta munayarsi mana aywamüragchu.
Nätan canan chay ruranäcunata nämi caypaga usharü. Chaymi cananga alisca aywamuyta munangänuy aywamushag gamcunaman.
Chauraga Espäñata aywalarmi yaycamushag, chaychru ishcay quima quilla cushisha cacurcushachr yanapapäcamanqui Espäñata pasanäpag.
Cananga aywayä Jerusalentaran apachicuycunata apacurcur.
Chaytaga Macedoniachru, Acayachru Jesusman yupachicugcunam yarpaylancunapita gotupäcusha, wac Jerusalenchru mana imaynag Jesusman yupachicug-mayinchicunata gonäpag.
Chaynuy rurarärira cay nirmi: “Paycunatag Diospita yanapasha cananchipagsi ali willapatas musyarayächimanchi. Chaura noganchis ofrendanchiwan yanapäshun” nirmi shuntarärin Jerusalenchru cagcunapag.
Chaura chay apachicarcamanganta nä gorcurga, Espäñata aywagnuylam yaycamushag gamcuna ricag.
Nogaga shumagmi musyayä gamcunawan nä tincurusha alisca cushicunanchita, jinaman Cristo ima-aygachrüsi yanapämänanchita.

Jesusman yupachicug-mayïcuna, Munayniyogninchi Jesucristo nimasha captinmi, jinaman cuyanacunanchipag Santu Espíritu yanapämasham cayta manacayärishay: Noga manacuyangänuynar gamcunas Diosta manacurcay mana imas pasamänanpag.
Manacurcay Judeachru Jesusta mana cäsucug runacunapita washamänanpag, jinaman chay apachicuy apayangäsi Jerusalenchru Diospa acrashancunapita alipa chrasquisha cananpag.
Chaura Dios munaptinga gamcunaman chrämuptï aliscam cushicushun, chaynuypa jucninchis jucninchis jamapacugnuy yanapänacunanchipag.
Shumagla cawachicug Tayta Dios lapayta ima-aygachrüsi yanapapäcushunqui gamcunata. Chaynuy cachun.
